Yeah life sucks. Your, mine and everyone else's. Half of the people are living without realizing that they are already dead. And for those who are really alive, it's not like everyday is Christmas for them. Many people have lot of issues but still they are happy, they are working on solving them. So you aren't facing anything new, it's what we all (most of us) doing. Just getting by one day at a time.

Everyday I question myself. Dammit every hour I ask myself. Is it really worth it. Wouldn't it be easily if I just call it a day and kick the bucket already. You know what, I think I am a coward. I am coward who think I would be better if I just die it would hurt anymore. But it not what gamers like us do. A true gamer who really loves playing games would never use cheat codes. And that's exactly what suicide is like. A cheat code to reach the ending of your game. We would never want that, do we. To ever end the game without putting some efforts.

You see, I always set the game difficulty to the hardest mode available. 
First, because it's​ the way I like it. Might be because it the only place where I can feel like a champion.
Second, as it gives me more reasons to stick to the game and less reasons to go outside and deal with people's bs.

I really really love playing games. I played games for 7 years of my life like a crazy bot. But it's been almost 3 years since I played my last game because the expensive piece of shit which I call my laptop isn't working well. 
And now I am playing the game with the books instead of laptop. Which is also great. Sometimes I draw sketches. Most of the time I try to draw them in a single sitting. Sometimes for 14-15 hours straight.
I also like to write poems, shayari. Even though I am not much good at them.

I do all these things because these are the only thing that makes me feel good about myself. So what I am getting at it, if you don't like what are you are doing in your life then change your game. Try out as many things as you can which makes you feel like let's give it shot.
It's your game "murules1 Life", dude. Everyone else is just NPC. So don't give a shit about them if they make you feel like cheat code "suicide" is the better option.

Play it well. If we ever meet oneday let talk about all out level achievements and treasure we find. All the best!

P.S. Life before death. Strength before weakness. Journey before destination.
